# Labcorp

> Labcorp is a global life sciences company providing diagnostic testing, drug development services, and clinical laboratory solutions for patients, healthcare providers, organizations, and pharmaceutical companies.

Labcorp operates three main business segments: patient diagnostics and wellness testing, provider and organizational healthcare solutions, and biopharma drug development services. The company offers appointment scheduling, test result management, specialty testing, clinical trials support, and real-world data analytics across a global network of laboratory locations.

## Key Topics

- Patient Portal
- Diagnostic Testing
- Clinical Trials
- Drug Development
- Biopharma Services
- EHR Integration

## Patient Services & Appointments

- [Make a Lab Appointment, Get Results & Manage Your Health | Labcorp](https://www.labcorp.com/patients): Patient hub for appointments, results management, and health testing services
- [Find a Labcorp Near You: Make an Appointment for Bloodwork and Drug Testing | Labcorp](https://www.labcorp.com/patients/labs-and-appointments): Find Labcorp lab locations and schedule appointments for bloodwork/testing
- [Find your Labcorp Test Results and Test Results FAQs | Labcorp](https://www.labcorp.com/patients/tests/results): Patient portal for viewing test results with FAQs and account access help
- [Explore Our Lab Tests | Labcorp OnDemand](https://www.ondemand.labcorp.com/products): Labcorp OnDemand test catalog: blood tests, health screening, wellness products

## Healthcare Providers & Organizations

- [Solutions for healthcare providers: Advanced diagnostic & specialty testing | Labcorp](https://www.labcorp.com/providers): Provider solutions: diagnostic testing, specialty services, EHR integration
- [Health System, Payor & Employer Testing, Tools & Partnerships | Labcorp](https://www.labcorp.com/organizations): B2B solutions for health systems, payors, employers: diagnostics and partnerships
- [Innovative Healthcare Services for Hospitals & Health Systems | Labcorp](https://www.labcorp.com/organizations/organizations-we-serve/hospitals): Hospital solutions: diagnostic services, lab management, clinical analytics
- [Managed Care Health Plans: Boost Quality & Reduce Costs | Labcorp](https://www.labcorp.com/organizations/organizations-we-serve/health-plans-and-payors): Health plan solutions: managed care, cost reduction, clinical outcomes
- [Explore our employee testing and wellness capabilities and solutions | Labcorp](https://www.labcorp.com/organizations/capabilities/employee-testing-wellness): Employee wellness and workplace drug testing programs for organizations

## Biopharma & Drug Development

- [Advancing Preclinical Drug Research & Nonclinical Studies | Labcorp](https://www.labcorp.com/biopharma/nonclinical): Nonclinical drug research: preclinical toxicology, pharmacology, bioanalysis
- [Centralized Laboratory Services for Clinical Trial Testing | Labcorp](https://www.labcorp.com/biopharma/central-labs): Central lab services for clinical trials: bioanalytical testing, precision medicine
- [Real world data pharma strategies for trial design & RWE | Labcorp](https://www.labcorp.com/biopharma/real-world-data-solutions): Real-world data solutions: trial design, RWE generation, patient identification
- [Labcorp trial kit orders | Labcorp](https://www.labcorp.com/biopharma/central-labs/trial-management/kit-orders): Clinical trial kit ordering system for global regional distribution
